challenge.method: Tested whether the generic publicdomain category could identify the Public Domain Mark, and whether the canonical edition URL alone could identify a summary instead of the legal code.
challenge.results: The zero unit, explicit edition title and numbered waiver and fallback identify a dedication that an owner applies to a Work. A mark identifying an existing public-domain work would serve a different function. The filename legalcode.txt, the “Creative Commons Legal Code” heading and the operative sections resolve the summary alternative.

limitations: Creative Commons describes a public domain dedication. The proposed registry kind “license” and lifecycle state “active” are index choices.
The Git file and live plaintext share one publisher lineage. Their matching digests establish consistency at acquisition.
reasoning: Creative Commons titles the English file “CC0 1.0 Universal.” Its own namespace documentation independently supplies the edition details needed to interpret that title, including version 1.0, Universal jurisdiction scope, language en, and the zero unit. The identification requires no inference from the SPDX name.
